blocks.x: Blockchain & Digital Trust applied to Fashion & Luxury. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Fashion and luxury sell scarcity, story and service: assortment risk (the size-curve problem), authenticity, clienteling quality and channel consistency. Technology must be invisible — but the intelligence beneath it decides which drops pay.

items: Counterfeits and grey market erode brand equity; verification manual.
Assortment and buy decisions guess curves; end-of-season markdowns absorb the error.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Smart Contract Engineering & Audit, Provenance, Traceability & Supply Chain Trust, Smart Contract Engineering & Audit from the Blockchain & Digital Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Assortment and buy planning, Boutique allocation, Clienteling and CRM) on Dataq Ledger and Dataq Sentinel. Governance inherits the sector frame — GDPR among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: On-chain transparency, operationalized: analytics, Travel Rule and MiCA-aligned controls.
Permissioned networks for multi-party truth: governance, consensus and integration done institutionally.
Instruments as tokens: issuance, custody and lifecycle under securities-law discipline.
Product-birth certificates with verification services (counterfeits contested)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Retail & Consumer Goods level this capability reads as: EUDR/DPP-grade chain-of-custody for claim-bearing products (claims verified, greenwashing risk down). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
